visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera is held in a selfie perspective by a middle-aged woman wearing a black and white polka-dot top. She walks along a sunny city street with a young girl in a white shirt and tan skirt. Behind them are green trees and urban buildings. (2) The scene shifts to a museum entrance where the girl looks at her smartphone. They stand in front of large posters featuring woolly mammoths and ice-age animals. (3) Inside the museum, various exhibits of prehistoric animal skeletons and models are shown, including a full-scale woolly mammoth and ancient skulls behind glass. (4) The woman and girl are seen walking down the stairs of a grand stone building with white pillars. (5) They are in a ramen shop; the woman uses chopsticks to lift noodles from a large bowl, while the girl sits across from her. (6) In Akihabara, they walk past the 'RADIO KAIKAN' building. The girl is later seen crouching in a shop filled with display cases of articulated dolls. (7) Back on the street, the girl shows a packaged doll to the camera, smiling. (8) They appear in front of a large Ghibli-style exhibition poster with a man in a grey shirt and cap. (9) Finally, they are in a bright dessert shop looking at pastries in a glass display.
